title: Oozy Kenyan Taleggio Gratin
description: A tangy kid-friendly Kenyan dish featuring Taleggio, perfect for slow-cooking, no onions or garlic needed.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Kenyan Cornmeal and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the heavy cream and stir until combined.
Bring the mixture to the boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes.
Stir in the Taleggio Cheese until melted and smooth.
Stir in the paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a 20cm (8 inch) oven-safe skillet or gratin dish.
Smooth the top and sprinkle with cilantro.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
Serve hot, straight from the oven.
Let sit for 5 minutes before serving to allow the cheese to set and the flavors to meld together.
